description: This file defines API handlers for managing categories and boards within a team, including creating, updating, deleting, reordering, hiding, and unhiding categories and boards in a project management application.

methods.name: registerCategoriesRoutes
methods.description: Registers API routes related to categories and boards within a team.

methods.name: handleCreateCategory
methods.description: Handles creating a new category for boards within a team.

methods.name: handleGetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves the user's category boards for a team.

methods.name: handleUpdateCategoryBoard
methods.description: Sets or updates the category of a specific board.

methods.name: handleHideBoard
methods.description: Hides a board for the user.

methods.name: handleUnhideBoard
methods.description: Unhides a previously hidden board for the user.
